steps: Webb’s size required a folded launch configuration.
Post-launch deployment carried many potential failure points and no repair option at that distance; deployment nevertheless proceeded smoothly.
In the second week, deployment reached the fully deployed configuration.
That physical milestone did not mean Webb was ready for routine science.
Commissioning included cooling, mirror alignment, and instrument calibration.
